title: Orbital Calculations

reward.description: A single gear from Babbage's great calculating engine. It remembers every number it has ever turned past.

hints: Plain recursion recomputes the same answers again and again. Store answers in a dictionary (memo) and check it first, or put @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None) above the function.
fewest_lenses: build a list best[0..focus] where best[0] = 0 and best[x] = 1 + min(best[x - lens]) over lenses that fit. Use a huge number for 'impossible'.
longest_shared_signal: make a table where cell [i][j] is the answer for a[:i] and b[:j]. If a[i-1] == b[j-1], it's table[i-1][j-1] + 1; otherwise the bigger of table[i-1][j] and table[i][j-1].
